programme.title: Ek Se Bure Do
programme.desc: Jagat, a gangster, hires Toti and Tony to steal a treasure map. But they provide him with a fake copy of the map and reserve the original. When Jagat learns about it, he plans to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: Kalyug Ka Pandav
programme.desc: A man falls in love with a woman, who unfortunately refuses to marry him due to a dark family secret. In response, his brothers devise a plan to unite the two lovers.

programme.title: Jigri Dost
programme.desc: Shobha prepares to marry an advocate named Anand as arranged by her father. However, she secretly follows him one day and is shocked to see him in the arms of another woman.

programme.title: Jagan
programme.desc: Jagan, an artist by profession, befriends two siblings on separate occasions and they both fall in love with him. He is forcibly married to the elder sister by goons, creating troubles in his life.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: Samay-when the time strikes
programme.desc: ACP Malvika Chauhan, a widowed mother, is assigned to investigate the murder of a businessman. However, she suspects it to be a serial killer as more murders take place in the city.

programme.title: Kahani Kismat Ki
programme.desc: A reformed man tries to make an honest living for himself and his family after his jail term. His life takes an ugly turn when a woman claims him to be her husband and he is also framed for murder.

programme.title: Khel
programme.desc: Three fraudsters trick a rich elderly woman, Sulakshana, who is desperately looking for her long-lost grandchild, in order to acquire her estate and property.

programme.title: Calling Bell
programme.desc: Karthik and Vyshali, a newly-wed couple, move into a villa and start living together. Soon, Karthik realises that his wife is a ghost and decides to get rid of her.

programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: Dev discovers that his wife, Reena, has been cheating on him with Ranjit. To teach them a lesson, he decides to blackmail the cheating duo as part of his revenge.

programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers' violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Naya Kadam
programme.desc: In a village ruled by Madhukar and Jaggu, who deprive the people of education so they can easily oppress them, Ramu manages to educate himself secretly with the help of a school teacher.

programme.title: Aulad
programme.desc: Believing his wife to be dead, Anand gives up his own child to Yashoda, who has lost her husband and her baby. However, he faces a dilemma when his wife returns.

programme.title: Lashkar
programme.desc: Anand, a professor, meddles with Sangram Singh, a gangster, but he gets acquitted in court. When Sangram seeks revenge, Anand joins hands with a policeman to defeat the crook.

programme.title: Saajan Ki Saheli
programme.desc: Kunti abandons her baby in order to lead a lavish life and marries a rich man. Years later, she realises that her husband is indulging in an affair and is shocked to find out the truth about the girl.

programme.title: Krantiveer
programme.desc: After being disowned by his family, Pratap, a juvenile gambler, ends up in Mumbai where he gets adopted by Laxminath, a landlord. However, when Laxminath is murdered, Pratap vows to avenge him.

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Prithipal Singh...A Story
programme.desc: Disappointed with his Olympic bronze medal, Prithipal Singh quits hockey and joins a university. However, things get worse for him when he is accused of murdering a student.

programme.title: Pighalta Aasman
programme.desc: Delhi-based businesswoman Arti Singh travels to Kashmir to claim her land from Suraj Arora. Soon after Arti and Suraj fall in love with each other, she learns that her friend Anu too loves him.

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Emergency MachinesMotorbike rider Grace shows off three amazing machines that were made to help people in emergencies. Grace puts out a real fire in an airport fire engine, shows off amazing search-and-rescue helicopters, and drives an ambulance.

programme.title: Waffle's After School Club
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Waffle's MagicMrs Hobbs thinks she has magicked Waffle the Wonder Dog away, but Waffle is on an adventure of his own, sniffing for a biscuit backstage.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: S2 E18 — HiccupsWhen one of the baby Pea-Rexes gets the hiccups, Ginger and the other two try all manner of cures to get rid of them.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: S1 E5 — The Octonauts and the Australian Outback MysteryWhile on a sister holiday in the Australian Outback, Dashi and Koshi search for a mystery crab to help evacuate it before a flash flood hits the area.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: S2 — The Tale of True FriendsWhen Benjamin is impressed by Lily's cleverness, Peter mistakenly thinks they no longer need him in the gang, but when Lily and Benjamin get trapped in Mr McGregor's Garden, Peter soon realises that his friends need him more than ever!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S1 E24 — The Acorn BadgeNorrie is upset when she sees a leaf fall from the tree. She thinks it's broken. She soon cheers up when she finds out that some trees shed their leaves in autumn, and actually it's quite good fun playing and jumping in piles of leaves. But ouch! What has Roly found?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S4 E25 — The Balloon BadgeDuggee is blowing up balloons for Tino the artistic mouse's birthday. When they give the tiny mouse a big bunch of balloons, something unexpected happens. Tino starts to float up into the sky! He's having a rather good time until he gets stuck in a tree. It's time for the squirrels to come to his rescue.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: S4 E8 — Solomon's Exciting DaySolomon and his friends are practising letters with Miss Gerrard. Outside, the children are going to the climbing wall area, and Mrs Collins has a challenge for them. Later, Solomon and Lusungu get arty and make their very own tie-dye t-shirts to wear, with help from Mrs Farrell.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: S4 E5 — Runner BeanEvil Pea wants to cheat Supertato and Runner Bean out of winning the supermarket race.

programme.title: Weasy Family
programme.desc: S1 E11 — Mission Bad PatientThe Chipmunk pretends to be injured so that the ducklings look after him.

programme.title: Do Not Watch This Show
programme.desc: S2 E3 — HobbyWizz is a pompous blue monster who is stuck in a TV show that he does not want people to watch. Luckily, Wizz's friends help him navigate the hilarious consequences of being the star of a show that he'll do anything to escape.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E46 — SlideBingo and Lila are very excited to play on their new waterslide.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E11 — CharadesBluey and Bingo spend the day at Nana's and want everyone to play charades, but their cousins Muffin and Socks are too young to understand the rules. Nana must quickly think of how to keep the game on track.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: S1 E13 — Flame BlameWhen Gadabout and Pearl lose the cure for Madam Dragon's missing flame, Zog helps them work together to assist his former teacher.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Mystery DoorDodge spots a mysterious door in the school hallway. The pups hear all kinds of exciting and curious noises coming from behind it, and their imaginations run wild. They have to find out what is inside.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: S3 E10 — Waffle Learns to ReadWaffle is banned from going anywhere near Sommersby School, so Gramps is at the Brooklyn-Bells' house to cheer him up. They play a game together on the front drive. Gramps and Waffle run in circles quickly, then slowly, before falling to the ground with laughter. Mrs Hobbs appears at her front door. She might have known it would be Gramps and Waffle making the racket. Mrs Hobbs reveals she's doggy day-caring Connie and Ruby's dog, Jelly. Gramps and Waffle can't believe it.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: The Multi Rafi WishRafi multiplies to tackle tasks, but chaos turns to harmony when she finally takes charge.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: S2 E14 — Spring: It's Time to Play BasketballJoJo and Gran Gran run into Jared and Cynthia who are playing basketball. JoJo joins in, but she doesn't feel like she is tall enough to play it well. They make an adapted version of basketball called 'JoJo Ball' instead. JoJo learns you can adapt things to make them easier.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: S3 E10 — Auto CatDuck has some competition for Sarah's attention when a brand-new toy arrives.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: S2 E4 — Snow BusinessThe cloud has been on holiday in space, but returns freezing cold and snowing, not raining. Tiny comes up with a clever plan to warm the cloud up.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: S1 E42 — BreatheMemo and Baba discover all the amazing things you can do with your breath.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: S2 E24 — Where Can Igglepiggle Have a Rest?Upsy Daisy is riding in the Ninky Nonk when she sees her bed. She gets off the Pinky Ponk and decides to have a rest in her bed. Igglepiggle is trying to find somewhere soft to have a rest.

programme.title: Cbeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: S2019 E54 — Jazz DogRobbie Williams reads tonight's bedtime story about a little dog with a big dream - to play beautiful music that everyone can enjoy.

programme.title: Villages by the Sea
programme.desc: S4 E5 — SolvaBen Robinson discovers the impressive lime kilns of Solva, Wales. This picturesque 19th-century port is famous for producing quicklime, a vital ingredient in both agriculture and the building industry.

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: S4 E3 — Lincoln to NottinghamAutumnal fog and an overheating engine prove to be problems for narrowboater Robbie Cumming as he navigates a Roman waterway and the fast-flowing River Trent. It's a journey of many challenges as he runs aground and breaks down in Nottingham.

programme.title: Rome: A History of the Eternal City
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Divine GambleHistorian Simon Sebag Montefiore charts the rocky course of Rome's rise to become the capital of Western Christendom and its impact on the lives of its citizens, elites and high priests. Rome casts aside its pantheon of pagan gods and a radical new religion takes hold. Christianity was just a persecuted sect until Emperor Constantine took a huge leap of faith, promoting it as the religion of Empire.

programme.title: Mary Beard's Ultimate Rome: Empire Without Limit
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Episode 4Mary Beard surveys the fortifications of Britain and Germany to understand the fall of the Roman Empire. She learns about the empire's struggle to control its borders. She seeks to redefine the general understanding of the so-called `Barbarian Invasions'. Besides, she shows that the empire was facing greater challenges from within.

programme.title: I, Claudius
programme.desc: S1 E10 — Hail Who?The increasingly insane emperor Caligula has appointed his horse as a senator and is terrorising his people. Unsurprisingly, Cassius and his conspirators plot to kill Caligula, but who will be emperor after him?

programme.title: I, Claudius
programme.desc: S1 E11 — Fool's LuckClaudius accepts the crown but does not spare Cassius for killing Caligula's family. Messalina persuades Claudius to let her rule alongside him.

programme.title: The Australian Wars
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Episode 2European immigration increases in Tasmania alongside the death count as Aboriginal people resist occupation and colonists encroach on the best land.

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: S1 E13 — RaspberryLive from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Raspberry performing It's Cool to Be Kind, and being extremely kind and very helpful to everyone.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: S1 E12 — Here I GoBing and Pando discover a new climbing frame at the playground. It has climbing bits, tippy bits and even a wobbly bridge. But when Bing gets to the top of the slide it's too scary for him to go down. Bing watches Pando to see how he does it, then he helps Hoppity Voosh to go down. When Hoppity likes it, Bing has a go too.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: S2 E20 — Fast Slow, Fast SlowThe Teletubbies take turns to go up and down on the Dup Dup. Sometimes they go fast and sometimes they go slow, and even the Noo-Noo has a go.

programme.title: Tee and Mo
programme.desc: S2 E5 — Kapow! Pew! Pew! Pew!Tee wants Mo to join in his big game but soon discovers she can't make the right action noises. Mo has to take drastic measures to get the noises right so she can be part of the fun.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Yellow Meets Red and BlueRed and Blue meet Yellow, and they have fun colouring the seaside.

programme.title: Bluey Minisodes
programme.desc: S2 E2 — PhoneyAfter a big day, everyone wants to sit back and listen to some relaxing music. Unicorse keeps getting Phoney to change the tune, and no one can agree on the best song.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: S2 E17 — BallPando is teaching Bing and Sula how to do little kicks and big kicks with a ball in the garden. Sula does the biggest kick of them all, but Bing kicks the ball the wrong way. As he tries to kick it back to Pando it bounces off the shed, breaking Flop's window! They have to stand statue-still while Flop cleans up the glass.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E14 — Top FunPreston needs Mojo's racer top speed to get his new plane off the ground. But when his flight goes wrong, Mojo and Bo have to take to the air in Mojo's jet top to help him down!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S2 E18 — The Making Friends BadgeThe Squirrels are off for a jamboree to make some new friends, play games and have a picnic. They meet another group of young animals with their very own version of Duggee but everything they do is different, even Roly finds one of them too loud.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S2 E19 — The River BadgeDuggee has a package that needs delivering to the other end of the river, a long way from the clubhouse. It looks like the Squirrels are going to have a day out on the boat. Good job Duggee has his river badge.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E47 — CricketDuring a friendly game of neighbourhood cricket, the dads struggle to bowl Rusty out.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E12 — Sticky GeckoMum must get Bluey and Bingo out the door in time for their play date with Judo, but the girls won't leave until they finish their game and the sticky rubber gecko falls down from the ceiling.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: S2 E35 — The Great Pacific Garbage PatchWhen a storm washes up lots of plastic litter onto the Go Jet Academy beach, the Go Jetters leave Ubercorn, Grandmaster Glitch and the cadets behind and head to the Pacific Ocean to try to solve the problem of the Great Pacific Garbage Patch. This is a massive collection of plastic garbage which has gathered together and floats in the ocean. It causes big problems for animals and seabirds which live in the oceans as they can eat the garbage or get tangled up in it.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: S3 — Peter's Great EscapeWhen the rabbits find themselves surrounded, Peter is forced to create a brand new ingenious escape route.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: S1 E8 — The Great Algae EscapeCaptain Barnacles and crew must catch a runaway Octopod, when it is hijacked by a group of crustaceans trying to escape their algae-infested waters.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: S5 E23 — Puzzle SquarePuzzle-master Thirty-Six challenges the others to find a way into Puzzle Square by opening locks with Numberblocks. Learn about solving problems with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Top of the Pups: Ten Green BottlesHennie sings a song about counting green bottles.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: S1 E14 — Top of the SwapsThe Penguins face a set of tricky problems, but they discover that swapping items and working together can provide clever solutions, turning a regular day into an extraordinary one.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: S1 E19 — The Great Gnome GamesAfter 799 years of winning the Great Gnome Games, Great Gnanna is worried she can't defend her title. To help, the doctors remind her she is just as fearsome as ever.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E39 — The Way of the WoodsA camping trip with Preston goes very wrong when he won't let them use Mojo's tops. But camping Preston's way soon starts a fire - it's Mojo and Bo to the rescue!

programme.title: A Complete Unknown
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Bob Dylan arrives in wintry 1961 New York to visit his idol, Woody Guthrie, in self-imposed convalescence at Greystone Park Psychiatric Hospital. An impromptu acoustic performance of a song that Bob has written for Woody propels his star into the ascendancy. Oscar-nominated biopic, starring Timothee Chalamet.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: Lady and the Tramp Sing-Along
programme.desc: Sing along with your favorite songs from 'Lady and the Tramp' with on-screen lyrics.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: An orphan is forced to live a life of servitude by her cruel stepmother. The king of the realm she lives in organises a lavish ball to find a bride for his son, and a caring fairy godmother puts her magic to the task of turning the downtrodden girl into a princess. Animated fairytale, with the voices of Ilene Woods, William Phipps and Verna Felton.

programme.title: Mufasa: The Lion King
programme.desc: Mufasa, a cub lost and alone, meets a sympathetic lion named Taka, the heir to a royal bloodline - a chance meeting which sets in motion an expansive journey of a group of misfits searching for their destiny. Prequel to Disney's live-action 2019 movie, with the voices of Aaron Pierre, Kelvin Harrison Jnr and Tiffany Boone.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Underwater princess Ariel becomes bored with her aquatic existence and spends her time spying on humans, much to the annoyance of her father. Longing to live on land, she strikes a deal with a banished sea witch in order to become human and meet a prince - but there is a price to be paid. Disney's animated adventure, with the voices of Jodi Benson, Christopher Daniel Barnes and Rene Auberjonois.

programme.title: Wish
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Asha makes a wish on a star to save her kingdom from rising evil and her plea is answered by a celestial body with the power to grant further desires. Animated fantasy featuring the voice of Arianna DeBose.

programme.title: Brave
programme.desc: A princess defies her mother's plans to secure peace by marrying her off to the son of one of their allies. A witch provides the rebellious royal with a magic spell to change her fate, but the enchantment backfires disastrously when the queen is transformed into a bear. Pixar's animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly.

programme.title: Mulan
programme.desc: A girl poses as a man so she can take her ailing father's place in the army and join in the battle against invading forces - a move that ensures her fame as a national hero. Disney animated adventure based on a Chinese folk tale, featuring the voices of Ming-Na, Eddie Murphy, BD Wong and Miguel Ferrer.

programme.title: Mary Poppins Returns
programme.desc: In 1930s London, Michael Banks lives in his family home with his children, Annabel, John, and Georgie. Still grieving the death of his wife, and behind on loan payments, his house is due to be repossessed unless he comes up with the money soon. Thankfully, help comes in the form of the practically perfect nanny who returns 25 years after her previous visit. Musical fantasy, starring Emily Blunt, Dick Van Dyke and Meryl Streep.

programme.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
programme.desc: The wise-cracking mercenary teams up with the resurrected X-Men veteran to take on a lethal adversary. Superhero sequel, starring Ryan Reynolds, Hugh Jackman, Emma Corrin and Matthew Macfadyen.

programme.title: Flightplan
programme.desc: A widow boards a plane with her daughter and promptly falls asleep. When she wakes up, the girl has disappeared - and the mother's fear turns to outright panic when the aircraft crew insists she boarded the flight alone, suggesting the child is merely a figment of her distressed imagination. Thriller, starring Jodie Foster, Peter Sarsgaard, Sean Bean and Greta Scacchi.

programme.title: Nightbitch
programme.desc: A nameless stay-at-home Mother tends to her young son in the suburbs while Husband casually goes out to work. Trapped in a whirlpool of rage and frustration about the loss of her identity, Mother becomes convinced that she is turning into one of the dogs that roam the neighbourhood. Dark comedy adapted from Rachel Yoder's novel, starring Amy Adams and Scoot McNairy.

programme.title: A Real Pain
programme.desc: Mismatched cousins David and Benji reunite for a tour through Poland to honour their beloved grandmother. Comedy drama, starring an Oscar and Bafta-winning Kieran Culkin, and Jesse Eisenberg, who also directed and won a Bafta for Best Original Screenplay.

programme.title: The Princess Diaries
programme.desc: An ordinary teenager discovers she is descended from royal stock and her grandmother is a queen. However, when this formidable regal lady insists she learn to behave like a princess, life suddenly becomes very complicated. Family comedy, starring Anne Hathaway, Julie Andrews, Heather Matarazzo and Hector Elizondo.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid

Disney's animated adventure, with the voices of Jodi Benson, Christopher Daniel Barnes and Rene Auberjonois.

programme.title: Maleficent
programme.desc: A fairy falls in love with an ambitious human nobleman, who betrays her in pursuit of claiming the throne. She swears to get revenge on him by placing a curse on his daughter, only to find herself developing a maternal bond with the girl. Fantasy adventure based on the story of Sleeping Beauty, starring Angelina Jolie, Elle Fanning, Sharlto Copley and Imelda Staunton.

However, when a little girl accidentally wanders into the pair's domain, they have to race against time to return her safely home before anyone finds out. Animated comedy, with the voices of John Goodman, Billy Crystal, Steve Buscemi and James Coburn.

programme.title: Raya and the Last Dragon
programme.desc: Chief Benja and his 'dragon nerd' daughter Raya proudly protect a luminescent stone that protects humanity from a plague borne of discord called the Druun. One poor judgement allows the darkness to return, and Raya embarks on a perilous quest to restore peace by completing a series of Indiana-Jones-style obstacles. Animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Marie Tran, Awkwafina, Izaac Wang and Gemma Chan.

There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A prince is transformed into a hideous monster as punishment for his selfishness, and can only regain his human form by finding true love. Salvation comes in the form of a spirited village girl, who offers to take her father's place when he is imprisoned in the monster's castle. But as romance blossoms between the unlikely pair, a jealous rival suitor only sees a beast to be slain. Live-action remake of the Disney animated fairy tale, starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans, with Ewan McGregor, Emma Thompson and Ian McKellen playing the Beast's entourage of living ornaments.

programme.title: Joy
programme.desc: An imaginative youngster with dreams of being an inventor grows up to be a downtrodden single mother, struggling to support her chaotic family. She sees a chance to turn all their lives around when inspiration strikes and she creates a new household tool, but faces the challenge of selling her product in the demanding world of a home shopping TV station. Fact-based drama, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Robert De Niro and Bradley Cooper.

programme.title: (500) Days of Summer
programme.desc: A greetings card employee looks back on his relationship with the woman he loves, after she has seemingly left him for good. As he recalls the key events of the 500 days he knew her, the ups and downs of their romance are presented in random order. Romantic comedy, starring Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Zooey Deschanel.

programme.title: A Real Pain
programme.desc: Mismatched cousins David and Benji reunite for a tour through Poland to honour their beloved grandmother. Comedy drama, starring an Oscar and Bafta-winning Kieran Culkin, and Jesse Eisenberg, who also directed and won a Bafta for Best Original Screenplay.

programme.title: Flubber
programme.desc: A scatty professor is in financial trouble, and his only hope of avoiding disaster is to market his latest invention - a strange rubbery substance with a life of its own. However, a criminal gang is determined to get hold of his creation. Remake of 1961 Disney comedy The Absent-Minded Professor, with Robin Williams, Marcia Gay Harden, Christopher McDonald and Wil Wheaton.

programme.title: Mulan
programme.desc: A girl poses as a man so she can take her ailing father's place in the army and join in the battle against invading forces - a move that ensures her fame as a national hero. Disney animated adventure based on a Chinese folk tale, featuring the voices of Ming-Na, Eddie Murphy, BD Wong and Miguel Ferrer.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Underwater princess Ariel becomes bored with her aquatic existence and spends her time spying on humans, much to the annoyance of her father. Longing to live on land, she strikes a deal with a banished sea witch in order to become human and meet a prince - but there is a price to be paid. Disney's animated adventure, with the voices of Jodi Benson, Christopher Daniel Barnes and Rene Auberjonois.

Event organiser Alice must break the news to chef Oliver that even more guests are attending than planned. Engineering twins Trevor and Alan take down a priceless Murano chandelier which hangs in Palm Court and is valued at more than half a million pounds. And executive pastry chef Andrew runs into a show-stopping problem involving a showpiece birthday cake.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks Italy
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Lemons & Blood OrangesTom explores Sicily's citrus heritage, from Siracusa lemons, once vital to British global exploration, to blood oranges coloured by Mount Etna's weather. Near Ortigia, he creates a Victoria sponge with lemon curd and candied peel, then on the Catania Plain prepares roast chicken, fennel and blood-orange vinaigrette for supper.

programme.desc: E2The Vietnam war changed aerial warfare in more ways than one. The Phantom became the first true fighter bomber of the modern era.

programme.title: World War Weird
programme.desc: E1Near the Czech border, a secret German site, "The Giant," tests The Bell, powered by Serum 525, turning all who touch it into rotting living zombies.

programme.title: World War Weird
programme.desc: E21942 and Hitler has the totally barking idea of using educated dogs to do a soldier's job. The Nazi leader wants to create fearsome canines to help him win the Second World War.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4The story of the prolonged development and the initially troubled operational history of the Boeing B-29 Superfortress. Forever known as the airframe that dropped the first atomic weapons on Japan, the B-29 lived on well beyond its war years.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The definitive, if not the best, Axis fighter of World War two: we delve into the story of legendary ace Adolf Galland and examine in detail and example of the type in his colours. We also look at the technical heritage the 109 designers left.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E3In 2008, nearly 850 people are killed in the Russo-Georgian War. How did it erupt and what is the current relationship between the two nations?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E4Soviet troops withdraw from Afghanistan in 1989 after fighting a force funded by the US. Should the US be blamed for the rise of Islamic terrorism.

programme.title: The Last Hunt For Nazi Gold
programme.desc: E1Historian Guy Walters begins his 4,000-kilometre European odyssey in Germany, tracing the first chapter of one of history’s most enduring legends. Alongside Justine, he leaves behind the archives to uncover the truth about hidden Nazi plunder.

programme.title: The Last Hunt For Nazi Gold
programme.desc: E2Guy Walters and Justine pursue the Amber Room in Czechia. At Friedland Castle, rumours link the fortress to the missing treasure. At the notorious Prince’s Hole, Justine braves the cave while Guy waits outside, only to find nothing but spiders.

programme.title: Nazi Murder Mysteries
programme.desc: E5The fact that Hitler’s niece, Geli Raubal, was found dead in his apartment in 1931 has remained a little-known footnote in the Fuhrers long and bloody legacy. The investigation concluded that she had committed suicide using her uncle’s revolver.

programme.title: Nazi Murder Mysteries
programme.desc: E6In this episode of the series, we look at the dark and disturbing tale of the skeleton of an unknown woman found in a hollowed-out tree in a Birmingham woodland.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E1In 1944, 28 Greek socialists were shot in Syntagma Square and 100,000 had perished by the end of the Civil War. Was this the old order Winston Churchill had longed for?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E2Since the Syrian civil war broke out in 2011, 400,000 have been killed in the conflict. Who is to blame for this and the terrible conditions in which its people live?

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The aircraft capable of delivering the payload of a B17, in a single post war air frame. The many variants of this single piston engined fighter bomber helped dominate the air to ground attack role in Vietnam, earning quite a reputation.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6The definitive combat helicopter saw first blood in South East Asia and has been transport, gunship, smoke ship, command centre, MediVac and dozens of other roles. We hear and see it's hair raising missions and watch it earn its fame.

programme.title: World War Weird
programme.desc: E7A 23-year-old Hitler, living hand-to-mouth as a painter in Vienna, Austria, discovers a sacred spear in the city's Hofburg Museum.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E1Two iconic machines of World War II - the Spitfire symbolised British hope and resistance, while the Tiger tank embodied German power.

programme.title: Al Murray: Why Do The Brits Win Every War
programme.desc: E4Al faces up to the richest nation on Earth to discover how the former British colony of America somehow slipped through its fingers.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The Grumman Avenger, which was the most important carrier-based torpedo bomber on American and British carriers throughout the Second World War. They were also the biggest and heaviest carrier aircraft of the conflict.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2The Junkers Ju 52, which is considered one of the most famous airplanes in history. It was first designed as an airliner, but was used as a transport, bomber, and air ambulance during the Second World War.
